products.name: Headliner
products.note: Podcast/video promotion; audiogram generation; social media; content marketing

reading.body:
Headliner is a video generation and editing tool oriented toward podcast and audio content creators, using audiogram generation and social media export as its primary outputs.

The product sits at the content-marketing end of AI tooling, where the computational demands are modest compared to large-scale generative video or foundation-model training. Audiogram generation, which overlays audio waveforms on static or animated images to produce short video clips, requires far less GPU throughput than full video synthesis, which places Headliner outside the infrastructure-intensive tier of AI applications this site most often covers.

The data here is thin. There are no use-case records, no model provenance details, and no information about the compute infrastructure or power draw behind the service. What it covers is the product category and its stated functions. What it does not cover is whether any generative AI capability underlies the audiogram or editing pipeline, or how that pipeline is hosted and powered.
